correction.supersedes_prior_mislabel: Circle Q2 2026 19.5% daily weighted-average USDC-on-platform share and $12.442B end balance were described as Coinbase platform metrics.
correction.corrected_definition: Those are Circle's own platform metrics. Circle's Q2 10-Q note 1579 defines Circle's platform as Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and non-custodial wallets offered through Circle. The 19.5% is Circle's daily weighted-average share of USDC in circulation held on Circle's platform; $12.442B is Circle's end-of-period Circle-platform balance.
correction.separate_coinbase_measure: Coinbase's Q3 2026 average USDC held in Coinbase products was $22B, up 49% YoY, per Coinbase's October 29 earnings release. It is not the same metric or period.
correction.preservation: Prior source, snapshot and graph records remain immutable. This correction is appended; no historical record is rewritten.

confirmed_facts.claim: Circle's Q2 2026 10-Q reports USDC circulation of $73.269B at period end and $76.524B average; reserve return rate 3.5%.
Circle's Q2 2026 10-Q reports $12.442B USDC on Circle's own platform at period end and 19.5% daily weighted-average share; note 1579 defines the metric as Circle's own platform.
Circle incurred $324.6M Q2 and $655.3M H1 distribution costs in connection with Coinbase agreements; these are Circle costs under the arrangement, not Circle's platform balance metric.
Coinbase's October 29 Q3 release reports $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products, up 49% YoY and approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization.
Coinbase's Q3 10-Q says the Circle arrangement was renewed on the same terms and higher average USDC balances added $84.6M to Q3 stablecoin revenue while lower average rates reduced it by $52.8M.
SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank each invested $25M in Circle at its June 2025 IPO; SBI's official presentation identifies the Circle SBI Japan K.K. / SBI Circle Holdings JV as 50/50.

Circle's Q2 2026 SEC filing confirms Circle SBI Japan K.K. was contributed approximately $1.5M-equivalent JPY by each party in November 2025; Circle consolidates it as a VIE despite 50/50 equity; no significant operating results through June 30, 2026.

SBI's current group profile lists SBI Group with 60% of SBI Ripple Asia voting rights as of 2026-03-31; SBI's February 2025 investor presentation states SBI 60% / Ripple 40% and approximately 9% Ripple shareholding at that time.

Circle's September 17 SEC 8-K records a five-year USDC promotion arrangement with Binance, monthly incentives tied to USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure, and a $100M private placement of 1,237,011 Circle Class A shares.
Circle's Q2 SEC filing identifies Binance as a strategic USDC distributor and corporate treasury holder; Circle's September 2026 agreement deepens that relationship.
SBI VC Trade's USDC distribution in Japan and RLUSD distribution are separate issuer relationships; Circle SBI Japan JV purpose is USDC distribution, not an XRP-specific route.
Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD have native XRPL deployments; no direct Circle-Ripple partnership is established by these sources.

sourced_claims.claim: Coinbase says it captured approximately 50% of all USDC economics over the past year.
sourced_claims.qualification: Company-reported characterization; the exact calculation and independent reconciliation are not provided in the release.

sourced_claims.claim: Coinbase reports 10.7% crypto trading-volume share, 12.5% assets-on-platform market share, 179% two-year CAGR in crypto derivatives volume, and prediction markets above $200M annualized revenue.
sourced_claims.qualification: Company-reported metrics; the prediction-market figure is annualized run-rate, not Q3 recognized revenue.

inferences.claim: SBI is a multi-issuer strategic hub with financial and operating exposure to both Circle and Ripple, while its operating subsidiaries distribute USDC and RLUSD and its group includes SBI Ripple Asia.
inferences.basis: Circle equity/JV, historical Ripple stake, SBI Ripple Asia voting rights, SBI VC Trade distribution.

inferences.claim: Coinbase remains economically important to Circle while expanding as a multi-issuer platform for USDC and RLUSD.
inferences.basis: Circle distribution costs, Coinbase Q3 $22B average USDC balance, renewed Circle agreement, RLUSD distribution.

inferences.claim: Binance's $100M Circle investment and five-year USDC promotion agreement create a durable distribution/equity link; Circle's issuer-level freeze capability remains distinct from that commercial alignment.
inferences.basis: Circle SEC 8-K and official partnership release; no common control inferred.

inferences.claim: Native USDC and RLUSD on XRPL may increase ledger utility but can substitute for native XRP as bridge in some USD-stablecoin routes.
inferences.basis: Native stablecoin issuance; no path-level XRP usage data currently confirms substitution or complementarity.

unknowns: Circle SBI Japan JV operating results, Japanese USDC balances and partner/customer distribution after 2026-06-30; Circle Q3 results scheduled 2026-11-04 08:00 ET.
Current SBI Holdings Ripple equity percentage and current SBI Ripple Asia remaining ownership beyond the 60% SBI voting-rights disclosure.
Exact Coinbase Q3 average USDC daily time series and Circle's Q3 platform share; the $22B Coinbase average and Circle's $12.442B Q2 platform balance are distinct metrics.
Coinbase's current Circle equity share count and voting rights; Q3 filing confirms an investment but the cited section does not quantify it.
Binance USDC balance through Circle Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure and exact monthly incentive amount; Circle's 8-K does not disclose the percentage.
Token-level RLUSD/USDC balances on Coinbase and route-level stablecoin/XRP settlement on XRPL.
Whether SBI's USDC and RLUSD distribution routes ever use native XRP as a bridge or collateral.

disconfirming_evidence.claim: Circle SBI Japan K.K. had no significant operating results through 2026-06-30.
Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue declined about 5.4% YoY despite higher average USDC balances because lower rates offset part of the balance benefit.
Circle says the relationship between interest rates and USDC circulation is complex, highly uncertain and unproven.
No direct Circle-Ripple partnership or shared reserve pool is established; shared XRPL deployment and common distributors are not sufficient evidence.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI is a multi-issuer strategic hub with financial and operating exposure to Circle and Ripple, rather than an exclusive issuer-alignment strategy.
support: SBI/SBI Shinsei invested USD50M combined in Circle; SBI and Circle own a 50/50 Japan JV; SBI historically disclosed approximately 9% Ripple ownership; SBI holds 60% voting rights in SBI Ripple Asia; SBI VC Trade distributes USDC and RLUSD.
counter: Circle SBI Japan had no significant operating results through 2026-06-30; current Ripple cap table is unknown; no integrated Circle-Ripple production settlement route is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase remains economically important to Circle while positioning as a multi-issuer exchange, custody and distribution platform.
support: Coinbase Q3 average USDC products balance USD22B; Circle Q2 distribution costs USD324.6M Q2/USD655.3M H1; Circle arrangement renewed same terms; Coinbase also distributes RLUSD.
counter: Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue fell about 5.4% YoY despite higher balances; rate compression offsets some balance growth; exact token-level revenue split unknown.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Binance's USD100M Circle investment and five-year commercial agreement strengthen USDC distribution and create strategic alignment, while increasing issuer/distributor concentration.
support: SEC 8-K confirms equity placement, wallet-balance-linked monthly incentive and Binance promotion commitment.
counter: Agreement can terminate on specified events; incentive amount and actual incremental USDC balances are undisclosed; Circle retains independent issuer/freeze controls.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Native USDC and RLUSD on XRPL may increase ledger utility but substitute for native XRP in some USD-stablecoin transfer paths.
support: Both stablecoins have native XRPL deployments and Coinbase/SBI distribution channels.
counter: No route-level transaction evidence quantifies XRP bridge substitution or complementarity.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle and Coinbase stablecoin economics are sensitive to reserve yields and distributor balances; balance growth can be offset by rate compression and incentive costs.
support: Circle Q2 reserve return 3.5%; Coinbase Q3 balance contribution +USD84.6M but lower rates -USD52.8M; Circle distribution costs are material.
counter: Stablecoin circulation can be driven by payment/utility demand; Circle states interest-rate/circulation relationship is complex and unproven.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade's live distribution is currently a more concrete USDC/RLUSD channel than the Circle SBI Japan JV's reported operating contribution.
support: SBI VC Trade public USDC distribution and RLUSD distribution announcements; Circle Q2 filing says no significant JV operating results through June 30.
counter: JV may have activity after June 30; Q3 results not yet available.

limitations: Circle's 19.5% and USD12.442B Q2 2026 platform metrics are Circle's own platform, not Coinbase.
Coinbase's USD22B Q3 average USDC products metric is separate and cannot be directly reconciled to Circle's Q2 platform balance.
Circle SBI Japan K.K. had no significant operating results through 2026-06-30; Q3 update pending.
SBI's Ripple equity stake is historical as of 2025; current cap table unknown.
No direct Circle-Ripple partnership, shared reserve pool or native XRP demand is established.
